central_claim: For selected reference transcripts and reported exon labels, four NR4A3 fusion models retain the complete NR4A3 moiety, the type-2 model adds 59 residues, and retained RG content plus TCF12 composition delimit untested recruitment hypotheses rather than establish ATR sensitivity.
source_overall_verdict: The bounded reference-model claim is supported by independent arithmetic and relevant source evidence. The outgoing package needs three focused export/presentation repairs before submission. No P1 scientific finding was identified.

blockers.title: Restore numbered references in both outgoing documents
blockers.exact_claim_or_location: Main section 8, PDF pages 16-18; supplementary References, PDF pages 4-5. In-text citations remain [1]-[10], but bibliography entries have no displayed numbers.
blockers.evidence: All bibliography pages were visually inspected. Both DOCX document.xml files have zero w:numPr elements, and the reference paragraphs contain neither typed numbers nor native numbering. The declared source has references 1-10. Numbered limitations were also flattened, leaving the reference to section 6, item 2 without a numbered target.
blockers.consequence: The actual outgoing files fail the specified numbered-reference format and require readers to count unnumbered paragraphs to match citations. This is an export defect, not a defect in the sequence results.
blockers.minimal_repair: Preserve ordered-list labels or native Word numbering for references 1-10 and limitations 1-8. Re-export main and supplement and confirm the existing citation mappings visually.

blockers.title: Preserve source scope and disclosure paragraphs in the actual main copy
blockers.exact_claim_or_location: Declared manuscript.md lines 553-568: blockquotes headed Scope of the claims and Declarations, including the statement concerning no new human participants, identifiable data, patient-level records, animals or laboratory work, and the detailed CRediT contributions.
blockers.evidence: Both paragraphs are present in the source but absent from actual DOCX XML and PDF. Pages 14-16 proceed from limitations to data availability and abbreviated Author declarations. The main copy contains no human-participant/ethics-applicability statement or detailed CRediT list. Funding, competing interests and AI assistance remain elsewhere.
blockers.consequence: The frozen source and outgoing document silently differ in author-declared scope and disclosure content. Biological limits recur elsewhere, so the omission does not turn the study into an efficacy claim; the submission copy nonetheless needs the intended declarations.
blockers.minimal_repair: Render these blockquotes as ordinary paragraphs or deliberately relocate their complete content into Author declarations. Preserve the existing wording and verify repaired DOCX/PDF against source.

blockers.title: Complete the separate figure legend
blockers.exact_claim_or_location: Separate Figure legend, page 1, contains only the opening Figure 1 sentence and generator/file names. Main caption page 8 explicitly directs readers to the caption to distinguish four marker types.
blockers.evidence: Structural and visual inspection confirms two paragraphs including the separate file's title. All Panel A-C explanations are absent, including operational boxes and the distinction between the reported EWSR1::ATF1 breakpoint interval and measured recruitment.
blockers.consequence: A production workflow using the separate legend would lose essential interpretation that remains in the main caption. The separate outgoing caption is incomplete.
blockers.minimal_repair: Populate the separate file with the complete interpretive Panel A-C caption, or remove the redundant short legend from the submission set if the full main caption is the authoritative upload. Retain explanations of every symbol and measured-versus-computed status.
